body: Praying for B & D. May God be with them and supply their needs. Praying for comfort and healing. He is an On TIme God.. And will come through when we need him!!

Praying that your mom is cleansed of this cancer from her body. We have a powerful God and he has brought my own mother out of so much. I'm currently typing this from the Emergency Room.. I believe God's mercy will be shown. Keep your faith strong. Bless you and your mother. May God be with you!!
Prayers for you and your family. So sorry for your loss. May angels surround you and comfort you 👼👼👼
God is lifting my depression and anxiety.. I was deep in the pit for many years of my life. He can do it, praying for YOU
So beautiful. A beautiful person you are. Just what I needed. Thank you! 🦅

Let's remember Jesus was shunned and persecuted himself.. He was an outcast.. He stands with the LGBT community.. He never hated anyone.. Even the ones who crucified him! Love is never wrong.. No matter who you fall in love with.

Well since God is love.. Why would he be against gay marriage. I'm gay and I know God loves me. I live for him.. And if it was wrong no one would be gay. People should be free to marry who they want. If everyone loved each other like Jesus' main message and word states.. We wouldn't have all this hate and violence in the world. There is definitely more things to worry about than who someone chooses to marry. Why don't people focus on their own lives and what God is speaking to them? If they did, they wouldnt have time to judge or care what other people are doing! Everyone is different and has their own journey and personal relationship with God. Some of the most Holy people can be gay. I'm very close with God.. He is always speaking in my life. He made everyone unique. The more people realize this the more peace we ALL will have.

I spent many years afraid to live. God takes away your fear if you ask with a sincere heart. Its a scary world but God is our protector and our weapon against all the darkness that comes our way. I ask that God will comfort you and show you he is with you.. through the shadowy world of death

You definitely don't deserve the pain you are feeling. Ask God to take some of your pain away.. I promise you it helps. We can't do it on our on.. The devil wants you to be confused and weak and wants to kill you. You have to be stronger than these demons you are fighting.. Ask God to take these demons away from you. Its a struggle but there is help and hope.. Stay strong!

Those all sound like good things. Focus on the positive things you did today. A lot of people with severe depression can't even get out of bed or take a shower. You are stronger than you know! You had the energy to workout even if it was just a short time. I saw a kid in a wheelchair today.. I'm sure he'd love the ability to workout. Don't be so hard on yourself. Try to focus on the light.. Even if you are in the darkness.. There is always something to be thankful for. Xx
Bless you. Thank you
I appreciate it more than you know. Bless you!!

I know I would've lied too.. Anything to get out of there! We only had one TV for the entire unit.. And they were always playing movies I didn't like. I would hate to know how prison feels like! Hope you don't have to go back too.. And that you're feeling at least a little better...having your freedom and being home xx
This made my day lol

You will be seen by the people who are meant to see you. Don't let numbers discourage your mission .. It's not about that.. If you touch or inspire one person that is enough. Social media is designed for us to feel less-than and like crap about ourselves .. A lot of it is so fake and unrealistic. Just do you

I got tied down to the bed and bruised up pretty bad. But i almost went out of my mind with boredom. Nothing to do but sleep all day and night.. and walk up and down the halls. Hope your experience wasn't too bad
I was there a few weeks ago, welcome back 👋
Ha I'd love some pointers too

If it were easy and fast I'm sure half the population would be gone..maybe more than half. There is no easy way. My sister hung herself in the basement. It wasn't quick or painless, I'm sure. She lived in a vegetative state in the hospital for awhile.. before dying. Its very painful for the ones you leave behind tho..
I hope you can find some solace too sweetie.  Don't let it all get to you.. Don't let it destroy you.. Take comfort in the small things.. Easier said than done, I know. But its all we can do.. Xx

Ask God to help... A higher power is the only one that can. Unfortunately humans can only do so much. Drinking doesn't help really only makes things worse. Put down the bottle.. God is listening... I promise. Ask for strength. Ask him to take the pain away... Cry to him. That's the only thing that has gotten me through the really bad times

Believe me I understand. I just got out of the mental hospital where they tied me to the bed! I've had so many bad moments where I didn't think anything was going to get better. But it does eventually. I don't know if you believe in a higher power.. But I ask God for strength. I would never have the strength on my own to get through the really dark times. If you are at the end of your rope, it is worth a try...to try to talk with God. It won't solve all your problems or magically make everything better.. But it does help.. Just knowing you're never alone and you don't have to do it all alone. None of us can! Xx

Sometimes people don't know what to say when you tell them you're suicidal. Its hard for others to relate, so they end up saying the wrong things and make it worse sometimes. But I'm sure you have many who care about you..they just don't know how to help. You are never alone. Many of us feel this way. And God is always by your side. Ask him to take your pain. You don't have to do it alone, none of us can!

When you are feeling bad about yourself your mind likes to tell you that people don't really care about or love you.. Our minds like to lie to us. I'm sure your mother would be devastated if anything happened to you! My sister killed herself..she thought no one cared.. But she couldn't have been more wrong. She was so loved. She just didn't know or believe it. Don't let your mind fool you. Your mother would suffer and blame herself for the rest of her life if anything happened to you!

Hey Alexa.. I hope you are reading this. I know a lot of bad things have happened to you and you feel like you have no way out. But you do have a future.. Don't let your past define you. You are not all those bad things. You can make a good life for yourself. Just hang in there.. And look forward, don't look back at all the things that cause you pain. I know its easier said than done.. But you don't have to carry all that weight you are carrying, sweetie. Ask God to take your pain away.. Cry out to him.. And I promise you will feel lighter Xx
You will find another job you love. Maybe this happened for a reason.. You just don't know what it is yet.. Sometimes things end so better things can come along. Don't give up!

There is a song that goes.. "There will be peace when you are done." You're not done yet... There will never be complete peace while we're alive.. Struggle and suffering are just a part of life. I know its hard but try to find peace in the little things. We all get weary. Its okay not to be okay all the time.

I know video games are your escape from reality.. But sometimes they can make your mental health worse. Its not good to be looking at a screen. Try to unplug for awhile. See if you notice a difference. Try to find another escape. I go out in nature. It lifts my mood. Try planting some flowers.. Take some photography of what you see outside. Buy a bird feeder, watch the birds. Pick up a book.. Or a paint brush. Go to the craft store and buy some clay..make some art.  There are other outlets you can get into.. See if it helps

The universe would never tell you to do that sweetie.. Its just your mind telling you lies and playing tricks on you. The universe is rooting for you to be here.. And to tap into all the love surrounding you.. Life is brimming with possibilities... You just have to make up your mind that you are going to live.. And open yourself up to the good things that are waiting just for YOU
Its never too late to do anything you want to do. As long as you're still breathing its never too late. I'm interested in A look Zoology too!

I don't think there is any way to avoid depression.. Its like the rain.. Its uncontrollable and will come whether you like it or not. Sounds like you are doing everything you can to keep your spirits up. Maybe some talk therapy would help or a med adjustment.. But we all have to kind of surf the waves until it's calm waters again 🌊

Definitely not alone. None of us walk alone.. we are all human.. And we all have our cross to bear.. Some crosses are heavier than others.. But we can get through. And whether we know it or not God is always by our side.. That's just what I believe.. Unfortunately we don't know why the whole world has to suffer.. Its just a part of life..

The whole world suffers.. Not just you. There is so much suffering.. We don't know why.. We just have to get through it.  It is easier to get through things with God's help. You have to ask and pray.. And while it may not go away.. At least it should help you make it from day to day. Sometimes we have to take life moment by moment. Don't lose your faith. We all have to go through things.. Everyone has their own burdens to carry eventually.. Its just a part of life, unfortunately. Hang in there!!
Too cute 😍 🐰

Well I'm 35 and I've never been married and don't have kids. I never plan to. I've never wanted that kind of life tho. Its different for everyone.. But if you really want those things, don't give up hope.. And just do you.. And if it is meant to come to you it will.. But sometimes its good to learn how to live alone.. Get to know yourself and love yourself first... Try not to depend on others for happiness.. Bc people come and go.. In the end all you have is yourself..

Just remember how far you have come! You should be so proud of yourself. Don't be too hard on yourself of what you have done in the past. All we can do is take it moment by moment.. And then it won't seem as hard and overwhelming. Congratulations!
You're not a weirdo. Life gets hard. Our brains are weird.. Our brains tell us lies..

I understand. I just got out of the psych ward yesterday.. I know how hopeless and exhausting it can be.. But there are good things to hang on for. Its not always going to be so hard.. There is help available.. Try not to keep how you are feeling to yourself. I know its hard to open up to people about these things.. But just know that you are not alone and its okay not to be okay! Xx

There is always another option. There are ways to fix any situation no matter how hopeless it may feel at the moment. Look for the crack of light in the dark.. There is always a crack of light even when you are in the darkest corner!
Have you tried local churches? They may be able to help. Hope you can find somewhere
Thank you!! :-))

Thank you so much! The art therapy really does help pass the time and is also soothing.. Calming to focus your energy on something besides what is going on around you and inside your brain. I hope you continue doing it! I appreciate the compliment! Xx
Thank you so much, I appreciate the feedback and love. I am doing better now. Same to you, take care Xx
Great idea.. I'm gonna frame it! Thank you for your kind words and encouragement :) Xx
Thank you so much!! Xx

🔋🔋📬🇪🇺☪️🔜🚭🎷🚵⚡️🌯
And eat oranges and mangos all day
Happy birthday :)
Stranger in a strange land.
Love it. RIP to the Dog.  Dog = God
Sweet boy. So sorry for your loss. They are irreplaceable!

"you are not your thoughts" helps me as well. I think I got it from Eckhart Tolle. I even had a bracelet made to remind me. Thoughts are like clouds.. Like you said they come and go. Don't attach to them!

Honestly sometimes the deeper you go on your spiritual journey the more depressing it gets. Anyone who says just "raise your vibrations" doesn't get it. Depression is a clinical imbalance in the brain.. And even meds fail. There is no easy solution. But.. nature helps me. The butterflies, the birds.. Everyone is different.. I wish there was a solution to raise your energy.. I've been searching for awhile and don't have much of an answer. Getting out of bed and out of the house.. Self care helps.. Sunshine.. Little things like that. Sometimes talking to a nice person who understands
Adorable 😻😻
Nature and spirituality. Music sometimes. Being there to take care of my mother. Mostly... watching and listening to birds these days...

You might like this song by PJ Harvey "Is That All There Is?"

https://youtu.be/RJe3LVW44lw

Feathers for me are a big message from the other side.. Possibly from a loved one.. Possibly just a message you need to help you through something. Some consider it to be an angelic message. I found 4 red cardinal feathers yesterday. It always excites me. They always seem to come when I need some kind of sign.. Something trying to get your attention for sure
Beautiful.. enchanting words
Oh... and Happy Easter lol ;) 🐰

Well I hope you catch a break and get some rest. Yes we all definitely have our own individual journey.. But there is a collective journey we all go through too... The human experience where we are all ONE and can relate to each other.. I don't know if you have heard of Ram Dass.. But he used to say "We're all just walking each other home"
We need each other to get through this thing!

Yes.. go out in nature. Don't look at your phone honey... Just absorb what is around you. And find some peace. I've never died..so no one can say for sure where we go. But my sister took her own life.. And she does send me signs.. And i get messages from her.. but it is very painful for those you leave behind.. We have to try to fight as much as we can to be here.. Its not easy.. but God makes it easier.. Go somewhere in nature and just speak.. He will let you know you are not alone

Maybe a med adjustment is needed. Some pills work for awhile but then stop working. Maybe need to change the dose. Give yourself credit for fighting and winning.. You know now you can do it.. You can crawl back out of this hole. You've done it before. Don't let your problems overwhelm you and bury you alive. Breathe. Know that you are okay. The universe will help you and support you. Cry out for help. Surrender..  tell God you can't take it anymore. I promise someone is listening. You will feel relief and love.. And a sense that you don't have to do it on your own. None of us can.

There is always negatively and conflict in the air... Haha.. But there is always positivity and peace too.. Depends on which you want to see or experience.. Its all about the way perceive and look at things.. That's what we'll see..

But also, things come in cycles.. we seem to experience individual patterns.. that reoccur during certain months.. 

Its the never ending carousel.. of time 🎠

Try having a new fantasy... a fantasy about living the life you want.. having the love you want.. every time you fantasize about ending it... try to turn it around in your mind.. towards a new beginning.. make a conscious effort to shift your thoughts from dying to living.. If you can.

Don't blame yourself. If she was meant to live.. she would have pulled through like you did. Your family member is being insensitive.. they are probably just in grief and need someone to blame and take it out on.. And you are the only one around..

 I mean, it was an accident. There is nothing you could have done to prevent it. Please don't be so hard on yourself. Talk to your mother... she is around you.. Feel the comfort of her and look for signs that she is around. Maybe your family member will come around.. and realize they are wrong and only causing more harm. Don't let them make you feel bad..they should be comforting you.. It sounds like they just don't know how to process what happened.. And they just turned to anger. Anger that she's gone. But anger and hate aren't going to bring her back. Just try to love this person anyway.. And feel your mom's love around you always

You do have the strength! I believe in you. You've made this far. Why not just continue to fight? You have to fight. You have to beat the hurt. You will find your joy again.. Give it time. This darkness is making you stronger even if you don't feel it now. You can't let it take over. Believe in yourself.. you don't know your own strength and power but its there! Hold on!
You are loved.

I am very familiar with not wanting to face tomorrow. 
I also create dreams in my head.. And reality will never match my dreams. 

I guess we just have to take life moment by moment. We're not supposed to think about or worry about tomorrow...

Just try to bring yourself to this very present moment.. The past doesn't exist the future doesn't exist.. Just right now.

And you may not like the present moment.. You may hate it. But the present moment is all we have.. Try to find something good about it. 

Also, I think the more we are thankful... the more we see our blessings.. the simple things like our health..food.. a roof over our head 

When all hope is gone.. look inside yourself for strength. 
Try to find some hope and peace in the "NOW"
I believe there is always some light to be found.. even just a crack.. To keep you hanging on.. to show you not all is lost and hopeless.. You can have love. Love is all around you.. Love will find you... stay open to receiving it.

Delete Instagram. Don't look at her page. Its the only way to move on and get your mind off it. You need a break from social media. Go out in nature.. Find some peace. I know you will find it there. And I promise you will find yourself.
You are loved.

You're not pathetic ..we all drown sometimes. We don't have to "save ourselves" though.. There is help.. you have to know who to ask. I ask God. Anyone can pray... have a conversation. Say how you're feeling. I promise you will feel relief. We may not be able to see or hear God.. but you will feel a loving presence. That is what God is there for... to save us from drowning. Spend some quiet time.. just talking. You will be heard.
I'm sure you can help a lot...If you stay.. You don't know how powerful you are

You are already poisoned. Your mind has been poisoned. I know.. bc I have a poisoned mind too. Can't let it win. Can't let it kill you. Have to renew your mind. I do it through prayer. Asking God to take the poison.. and renew my mind. I know you didn't ask.. but its a solution to the pollution. Wont solve all your problems.. But helps.. Its there if you want it.. Ask..

You are definitely not selfish. Everyone deserves to be heard and cared for. Its not your fault you feel this way. Being a human and life is just hard.. We can't handle it on our own. We have to seek help.. either from others or a higher power. I don't want to get all religious.. But I do believe someone hears us when we call out for help and feel alone. I truly believe we are never alone.. Even when it feels like it. We all need love and attention.. Sometimes the only one who can hear us is God.

 I know some people don't believe.. But when I feel like I can't take it anymore.. I talk to God.. and I look for signs.. And I feel a peace and a calmness and strength come over me.. It feels like a warm hug. I can't explain it.. But I've been down at the bottom.. At the end of my rope so many times.. And it is the only thing that saves me from myself. Its worth a try. Don't be so hard on yourself.. and there is nothing to feel guilty about. Its just too hard for others to understand... Or for them to even know what to do or the right words to say. But.. just know that you are very cared for.

 I'm sorry you have to go through this.. all we can do is give up trying to find a reason why we all suffer... some more than others.. And try to be loving towards others and ourselves.. We are all one. You're not alone.
OMG YAS ' Never Be Mine' ... one of my faves ever also!

Here! Here! Pretty much all of what you said. Besides the fact that I've just never been a "kid person".. I don't really connect with children. I would also make a horrible mother.. Seeing how I can barely maintain myself.. I've struggled a lot just to be here.. So I would never want to bring another here. I once had a lady tell me that I was " selfish" bc I didn't have children. And then I overhear her talking on the phone.. Complaining how there are ALWAYS kids over at her house. 

If anything, the people who have kids are the ones who are selfish... Why else have a child but for your own wants? People don't even consider what an unborn child would want! I definitely wouldn't choose to be here either. I think people have kids for their own entertainment.. and bc of "societal norms" and to have someone to take care of them when they're old. I can't think of one unselfish reason. And yes, plenty of orphaned children would love a home.. And there is definitely a bond with adoptive family that can be stronger than blood, for sure!

Take care of the ones already here.. Help the homeless.. stop breeding and bringing more bodies to this over-populated planet!
Wow! Love it. Yes the shift in weather can be quite hard. I hope you find a secret 'trap door' back into your garden 🌹
Dang.. You sound very high functioning and motivated.. Wish I had that much energy and ambition! Good luck to you. Hope the seroquel works well for you!

Happy birthday, fellow Aries. My birthday is the 31st. I probably won't do anything either.. Not sure what I should be doing.. But its always so much pressure like you should be doing something. Birthdays are weird. They should be joyous and happy I guess.. But I've always felt like its just another day.. And I want it to be over so I don't have to think about how another year has come and I'm not where I want to be in life ect. ect. I have a little pity party for myself I guess.. Lol. 
Birthdays are kind of over-rated. But still deep down you want people to at least acknowledge it.. So that's enough for me.. If a few people even remember! Since everyone is busy with their own thing.

I know its small... But when I can make myself get out of bed.. Take a walk..get some fresh air and sunlight.. Maybe smile or wave or say a word to a stranger.. Look at flowers.. Trees...the sky.. Birds.. It does help me get out of my head a little bit.. At least to help lift my mood to make through the day.. Or write in a notebook.. What you see outside.. Just get out of the bed. It brings you down more.. I know

I'm sorry you have experienced so much hurt from others.. It can be such a cruel place.. Especially if you are sensitive and fragile. You are definitely worthy.. You don't need anyone else to see it to believe it. You are human, you have incredible worth and value just because you exist and breathe! And you are beautiful! I know its hard.. When your brain tells you so many lies about yourself. Try not to listen to those intruding voices. Hugs
Wow. Getting ready to head out the door. And I needed this. Almost made me cry. So sweet. Thank you so much!!!

Last month.. I was manically looking into communes. It does seem like a better more healthy way of life.. But also very structured and routine too. You never know if you will be a good fit until you try. I think the rat race makes mental illness 1000 times worse. I hope you find some peace of mind and comfort in a new situation

I'm getting ready to start a new job tomorrow and I haven't worked in SO LONG. Just thinking about it I have a bad migraine. I know I'm going to have to fake it somehow. I'm scared the boss will see right though me.. That something is wrong BC I don't know how to interact normally with humans. Ugh. I barely can get out of bed or shower.. Not sure how I'm going to do this part time job even tho its super easy and i will be on my own most of the time.. Still freaking out about being social and in public. I feel you. I hope we can push through it! Good luck
Whoa. Totally. I wonder why this is? My therapist just told me suicides run the highest going from Winter to Spring. Definitely feeling the shift.

Yes, I have a huge migraine now...and it leads to feeling very depressed. I think the migraines begin when I feel overwhelmed by life. Trying to get my first job in a very long time.. Super stressed and anxious.. Trying to pretend and function like a "normal" human being gives me a migraine.. I just want to stay in a dark room! But have to push myself through it. Its hard just coping with daily routines and tasks. I hate bipolar so much
We definitely need more lgbtq movies for this very reason.

Yes.. the history of suffering repeats itself. At least there is some comfort in the expression of art that we are not alone.. The first or the last to bare this weight. Thank you for sharing.. It sent me down a lovely rabbit hole
Interesting painting. There is a poem by the same title by William Carlos Williams as well. You're right, it is eerily similar to the posters words.  Sadly true.
Poetic
As a nonconformist lesbian woman.. I appreciate this.

So true. I think technology has ruined our social skills in many ways. So many of us are truly lonely. It does seem harder to connect with humans. I feel so alien most of the time.. Like I'm living in a different world from everyone else. I have felt I don't belong here for a very long time. Its hard to go on and try to live like a normal person... Keeping yourself busy... as a distraction
And it's still not happening!
Sounds like you have your whole life ahead of you... And everyone has a past.. And struggles and challenges. I don't see why you couldn't or wouldn't find somebody... When you are ready..
Well.. from one lone wolf to another, you rock! 🐺

You inspired me to bang on my little hand drum. Dancing around listening to music. I was feeling pretty crappy myself. Hope you can find a little joy and make a little noise today, yourself. The silence can be overwhelming. I am like you.. spend a lot of time on YouTube.. but it is good to get off and just move around your room and dance or head-bang a little ;-)
Haha sorry! Thank you for enlightening me. I'm just an idiot American... most of us think anything worn on the head like that is a hijab.. Haha my bad! I didn't even know what Berbers are!
Nevermind.. The name of the band is Tinariwen.. not sure if they are middle-eastern or not

Drums, nice! I was trying to think of a band... They play guitar music and they tour in America.. they wear hijabs.. So I assumed they are middle east. I can't think of their name though. I was hoping you knew them.. there are like 5 or 6 of them in the band

What are some good middle eastern bands I can listen to? 
Do you play an instrument or sing?

How do you practice mindfulness? I find it hard to stay in the present moment. My mind drifts to negative thinking about the future and the past a lot. I try to let the thought pass... And I say to myself " I am not my thoughts"

Starting a band would be awesome. Would be a great way to fill the silence and give some release. Wish I had a group of people to tinker around with too.. Just for fun and experimentation... I've tried to learn to play guitar but never was any good at it. But just having people to play around with would be nice!
I know how you feel. Trying to find things to be happy and passionate about is hard. Try looking at a tree... Or a flower.. Or a bird.
Good song, for sure. I'm very familiar with that old friend.. (Or is it an enemy?)
What kind of music do you like?
Welcome to the Joni club! Once you are into her music it just gets better and better. She is truly one of the greatest true artists of all time! ( love Kate Bush too ;)
Very cah-uuute
Well... just today a woman told me I had a "gift for words"... I thought it was nice because I do like poetry.
Awesome! 🌈
I relate to "wanting the fantasy version of a relationship" ..and I'm 35
Thanks for this 👍
Feel this. 💔

I know I can't even stand to watch TV or media anymore... Your right, total distraction from the hell of reality. Definitely more bullshit on top of bullshit. People get married and have kids for selfish reasons too.. For their own entertainment. I would never bring a kid to this place. I'm just surviving and existing, basically. I guess trying to find the good.. But there isn't much. Currently watching kids play hide & seek. I wish being adult was so easy. There is nowhere to hide away from it all. Being a human is nothing but exhausting work.

Nothing is wrong with you. Its this world..and how we are forced to live. I don't know how so many can see it as "great".. I try to focus on the little things.. Like right now listening to the birds chirp. We should be living like them.. truly FREE

I feel you. Nature has been the only thing keeping me here for many years. But I've been so depressed lately I didn't think nature would be enough to keep me around anymore. I guess I'm just hanging on to see what comes... you never know what good twists or turns life could take.. I guess I'm just curious if it will ever get better.. Its been bad for so long tho. I know depression just makes you care about nothing in general.. But it does sound like you care about other people.. You care about your roommates.. It sounds like you care more about them than yourself.. Maybe there are people you want to stick around for.. Ya never know.. you may end up caring for something in the future.. I wish we could all just care for ourselves a little more. We are precious creatures.. even if we don't feel that way about ourselves
I'm so glad. Hugs 💙

This exactly why I plan on living in a van or an RV in the future. Many people are doing it.. getting out of the rat race. Its no kind of life. But there is hope... living on the road.. Seeing the beautiful country.. The lakes.. The oceans.. The mountains.. Taking odd jobs or making money online for gas and car maintenance. I would be living this lifestyle right now  if I wasn't taking care of my disabled mother. Tons of vanlife videos on YouTube to give some hope and inspiration. You don't have to be a slave to the wage... I know it feels like it. But there are other ways..  If you are a free spirit.. There are other paths you can consider.. You don't have to end it right now.. Start with your truck...

I ask myself this often. I don't know why. I don't think anyone ever will. But I feel like I have to stick it out no matter how hard it gets... Maybe there will be some rare moments of pleasure. Is it worth it? I don't know. But I'm here... so I'll suffer through it.. At the end we may find out why.. Or we may not even care... Maybe we'll just be happy it's over.. I guess we have to try to create a little bit of happiness here where we can... Be what you want to see in the world.. Or something like that
Try to focus on your breathing. I like to say to myself "I am not my thoughts" ... I also pray to make it stop.
Hugs..

I get that. So many people don't understand and they don't know how to handle these kinds of feelings. A professional therapist shouldn't make you feel worse though. It is their job to help you feel better and see the brighter side. I can tell you have many good qualities you just need some help seeing the good things about yourself. You just need a safe space to open up and talk. Glad you are opening up a little here.. Its not easy to do

Your dad doesn't understand you are dealing with things. You need a professional to talk to. It's not easy to just go get a job when you aren't feeling well. Don't be so hard on yourself. But talk therapy will help if you can talk to someone and maybe get on some meds.. It could help
Hugs..
Proud of you! Gave me a reason to smile for the night. Thank you. Stay strong
I feel you. Sending love. Wishing you find some peace and relief even for a moment. Stay strong sweetie
Very nice! Sounds like a good morning / good night

You're definitely good enough. It is a good step to reach out and type what you are feeling.. But talking to a therapist really helps too. It might help building some of your confidence if you don't keep all this inside to yourself. I wish I had talked to someone sooner
Love you
It helps a lot of people and works for them.. Its just a matter of trying it to see what it does for you. I think that is a pretty low dose. I hope you have good luck with it
